intro: Bahrain was the first Middle Eastern country to host a Formula One Grand Prix.

chapters.title: Formula One
text: The Bahrain Grand Prix, first held in 2004, often opens the season. Bahrain's Sakhir circuit is lit for night races.

chapters.title: Athletics
text: Bahrain's Olympic medals have come in athletics, including Winfred Yavi's steeplechase gold in 2024.
